instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing left. He extends his right arm to punch the left shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands upright on the left facing him. The background features dark partitions and studio equipment under bright, even overhead lighting.
